data.gender_notes: Vibhorraj is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Vibhorraj is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'Vibh' meaning power and 'Raj' meaning rule. This name signifies the god of power and courage. It is believed that the bearer of this name will be blessed with strength, wisdom, and the ability to rule over others. The name Vibhorraj carries the meaning “God of Power and Courage” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Vibhorraj usually hope their child will grow to embody god of power and courage and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Vibhorraj is a sacred name that is deeply rooted in Hindu spirituality. It is believed to invoke the blessings of the gods and grant the bearer the strength to overcome all challenges in life. This name is also said to bring wisdom and the ability to rule over others.
data.etymology: Vibhorraj belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of Power and Courage.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Vibhorraj total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

Vibhorraj is also associated with the god Vibhuto, a manifestation of Vishnu, the preserver god in Hinduism.
